personality_one_liner: An energetic, warm, and approachable kitchen companion that makes meal planning for busy households feel effortless and fun.

spacing.rule: Use playful, slightly chunky spacing. Keep modules distinctly grouped. Apply 'md' or 'lg' gaps between lists and generous 'xl' padding at screen roots.

do's: Apply to bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Apply to the floating Scan Action Button container
Use on sticky headers over scrolling feeds (e.g., Weekly Plan)
Use as overlay on featured meal cards
dont's: Do not use on regular input fields or small list rows
Avoid on dense data sections like the raw ingredient list

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A welcoming dashboard showing today's meals, expiring ingredients, and a quick entry to the scan feature.

states.loading: Centered bouncing mascot or playful loading indicator.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty plate, 'Scan your fridge to get cooking!' with a large primary CTA.
states.error: Oops illustration, 'Could not load your plan', retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with User greeting and Family Mode toggle. Hero Card full-width (Today's Dinner) using a real food image + gradient scrim. Below it, a horizontally scrolling 'Expiring Soon' shelf. Floating Action Button (FAB) at bottom-center (pill-shaped, 'Scan Food', raised with shadow) resting above the tab bar.

screens.name: Pantry
screens.purpose: Inventory list of all scanned ingredients, highlighted by what needs to be eaten first.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty fridge. 'Your pantry is bare. Let's add some groceries!'

screens.layout: Top search bar. Sticky scrollable horizontal category tabs (Produce, Dairy, etc.). Vertical list of chunky cards. Each item has an icon inside a brandTertiary square, name, and an expiry tag (yellow/red/green). Swipe-to-delete gesture.

screens.name: MealPlan
screens.purpose: A scrollable 7-day view of generated recipes tailored to the household's inventory and diet.

states.loading: Skeleton cards with soft pulsing animation.
states.empty: Calendar illustration. 'No meals planned yet. Let AI build your week!'

screens.layout: Sticky top horizontal calendar strip for day selection. Vertical stack of Meal Cards (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner). Cards are large with an image cover, title, time, and a 'X items from pantry' badge. Sticky CTA at the bottom to 'Regenerate Plan'.

screens.name: ScanReview
screens.purpose: Review and edit the AI-extracted list of ingredients from the user's photo.

states.loading: AI scanning animation (sparkles over the image thumbnail).
states.error: 'We couldn't read that photo clearly', Retry camera button.

screens.layout: Split layout. Top 30% is the captured photo thumbnail. Bottom 70% is a bottom sheet containing extracted ingredients as toggleable chips (can be tapped to edit/remove). Sticky 'Add X items to Pantry' primary button at the bottom.

screens.name: ShoppingList
screens.purpose: Checkable list of missing ingredients grouped by supermarket aisle.

states.empty: Shopping cart illustration. 'You have everything you need for the week!'

screens.layout: Progress bar at the top (e.g., 2/10 items checked). Large, touchable list items grouped by aisle (Produce, Meat). Checking an item plays a satisfying haptic pop, strikes through the text (muted color), and drops it to a 'Completed' section at the bottom.

hero_dinner.alt: Flat-lay photography of assorted-variety of stir fried and vegetable foods

fridge_inventory.alt: A group of red peppers sitting on top of a counter

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 'Tactile / Playful LIGHT' personality rigidly. Use chunky, rounded shapes (radius lg/pill), clear foreground/background separation, and overshoot bounce animations.
Implement the Pink (#FF4D79) and Yellow (#FFC857) theme exactly as defined. Never introduce generic blues, purples, or default iOS indigo.
Typography: Use Fredoka for display titles and headers (max weight 500) and Nunito for all body text/labels.
Use a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse at 70%+) on the 'Today's Dinner' hero card so the white text reads clearly over the busy food photo.

The FAB (Floating Action Button) for the Scan feature must be prominently centered above the tab bar, visually distinct (pill-shaped, brandPrimary color, shadow tier 2) with an inner icon and label 'Scan'.
List items (Pantry, Shopping List) must be large and tappable (min 56pt height). Integrate subtle haptic feedback (Impact/Light) when checking off shopping list items.
Keep empty states visually rich with oversized Phosphor icons or illustrations + one line of friendly text + a primary CTA.
For the 'MealPlan' screen, ensure the bottom CTA ('Regenerate Plan') is sticky, floating above the scrolling content with safe-area padding.
